Home / Equipment / Drilling Rigs / KD-2500 Special Deep Rotary Drilling Rig (2500 m)
2500 m // 2 × MAN 422 (844 HP)

2500 Meter Special Deep Borehole Drilling Rig

Dual MAN 422 Engines, 14.50 m Mast & 7.5×10 Integrated Duplex Mud Pump

Engineering Overview & Purpose

Engineered for uncompromising reliability in remote and severe geological conditions, the KD-2500 special rig features dual MAN 422 diesel power units delivering redundant torque, a 14.50-meter reinforced mast, and a heavy 7.5×10 duplex mud pump for continuous 2500-meter drilling operations.

Field Applications

  • ✓ Deep geothermal energy exploration down to 2500 meters
  • ✓ Large-diameter regional water extraction wells
  • ✓ Hard-rock mineral exploratory drilling and deep core recovery
Geological Stratum Compatibility:

Abrasive quartzite, andesite, basalt, massive limestone, and complex tectonic strata.

Engineering Q&A Direct Answers

Q: What are the key specifications of the KD-2500 special deep drilling rig?

A: The KD-2500 features dual MAN 422 diesel engines, a 14.50m mast made of 8mm wall-thickness structural pipe, a 5x510 heavy-lined drawworks, an OD 700mm rotary table with 850mm hydraulic sliding stroke, and an integrated 7.5x10 duplex mud pump.
